svg.text: Recovery Workbench · build calendar, December 2026 to June 2027

19 microservices built in two parallel streams with agentic development. Each service stays in one stream and is built only against its published contract (gate G7), so every bar is one independently deployable module.
Wave 0 platform (7 PLT epics: template, libraries, workflow kit, DB, events, edge, observability) and the E1 release on 30 Nov (9 Wave 1 services)
Bar colour = release the work goes live in (all dates tentative)
Template, contract libraries, workflow kit, events, edge, observability: versioned upgrades only (built in November)

Source: Release Plan v5 (release and SIT/UAT dates, unchanged and tentative), Ownership Map v1 (19 services), Jira Impact v1 (7 PLT, 19 SVC, 5 ITG epics). Build is continuous; SIT and UAT take the two weeks before each release. Decision D-RCV-60.
